description: shipwright hooks for Codex. Same four scripts as .claude/settings.json, from .agents/hooks/. Codex supports SessionStart, Stop and PreToolUse; UserPromptSubmit (recall.py) is wired the same way but unverified on Codex — recall.py reads the `prompt` field and prints nothing if Codex sends another shape. Three limits: (1) Codex has no CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR, so each command sets it from the git root; (2) guard_edits.py reads tool_input.file_path, which Codex's apply_patch tool does not send, so the edit guard is inert on Codex until the hook learns the apply_patch input shape; (3) chat capture in stop_handoff.py needs transcript_path, which Codex is not known to send, so capture does nothing on Codex and only the handoff reminder runs. Project hooks run only after you trust them with /hooks.
